subject.title: fix(infra): release exec-approvals locks across VirtioFS identity drift

question: Should this PR become the canonical exec-approvals lock fix, replacing the overlapping approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028 once it supplies exact-head live evidence?
rationale: Both branches address the same authorization-store failure but differ in hardening and proof freshness; choosing a single long-term owner-boundary implementation is a maintainer security and maintenance decision.

options.title: Adopt this current-main replay
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch after it adds redacted current-head runtime proof from the affected or equivalently representative filesystem path.

options.title: Adopt the earlier live-proven branch
options.body: Rebase and harden https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111028 instead if its production proof and implementation are preferred.

options.title: Request a shared dependency design
options.body: Pause both PRs if maintainers want the sidecar-lock protocol corrected first in @openclaw/fs-safe rather than locally at the exec-approvals boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt this current-main replay
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch after it adds redacted current-head runtime proof from the affected or equivalently representative filesystem path.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the production investigation and authored the overlapping implementation, making them the strongest available technical routing contact for the canonical-choice discussion.
